text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"longer developed paragraphs with repeated examples","quality":"development","description":"The essay expands ideas with multiple supporting points instead of stopping after a single brief anecdote."},{"evidence":"uses section-like questions such as 'How does sharing experience helps us in our future??'","quality":"organization","description":"The essay is more clearly structured into separate idea blocks that guide the reader through the response."},{"evidence":"connectors like 'also', 'because', 'so', 'then' throughout","quality":"transitions","description":"The essay uses more explicit linking words to connect ideas and show relationships between sentences."},{"evidence":"more complete explanatory sentences about future, school, job, and choices","quality":"elaboration","description":"The essay explains a general point in several different contexts rather than relying on a single example."},{"evidence":"varied sentence openers such as 'It helps you in future...' and 'We should share...'","quality":"sentence variety","description":"The essay shows somewhat more control over repeating the same thought in different sentence forms."}]}
